title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 5)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 5), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This session addresses and refutes arguments used to assert physical limits for the divine essence.
